statement.zh: Habu 案例研究将三内丸山表述为复杂采集—渔猎社会中的大型绳文聚落，并讨论其兴衰（Habu 2008 Antiquity）。
statement.en: Habu’s case study frames Sannai Maruyama as a large Jōmon settlement in a complex hunter-gatherer society and discusses growth and decline (Habu 2008 Antiquity).
